name: Total Carbon Footprint
expr: CFtotal = Σ(Activity Data × Emission Factor)

name: CO2 Equivalent (CO2e)
expr: CO2e = Σ(GHG mass × GWP)

name: Global Warming Potential (GWP)
expr: concept: measures how much heat a GHG traps relative to CO2 over a time horizon

name: Per Capita Carbon Footprint
expr: CFpc = Total Emissions / Population

name: Carbon Intensity
expr: CI = CO2 Emissions / GDP

name: Emission Factor
expr: concept: mass of pollutant released per unit of activity or fuel consumed

name: Scope 1 Emissions
expr: concept: direct GHG emissions from sources owned or controlled by an entity

name: Scope 2 Emissions
expr: concept: indirect emissions from purchased electricity, heat or steam

name: Scope 3 Emissions
expr: concept: indirect emissions occurring in an entity's value chain

name: Carbon Sequestration Rate
expr: CSR = Carbon Stored / Time

name: Net Carbon Balance
expr: NCB = Emissions − Sequestration

name: Fuel Combustion CO2 Output
expr: CO2 = Fuel Mass × Carbon Fraction × 44/12

name: Vehicle Carbon Footprint
expr: CFvehicle = Distance × Fuel Consumption Rate × Emission Factor

name: Electricity Emission Factor
expr: EFelec = CO2 Emitted / kWh Generated

name: Carbon Payback Period
expr: CPP = Embodied Carbon / Annual Carbon Savings

name: Life Cycle CO2 Emissions
expr: concept: total emissions across a product's raw material, manufacture, use, and disposal stages

name: Carbon Offset Cost
expr: Cost = Emissions to Offset (tCO2e) × Offset Price per Tonne

name: Deforestation Carbon Release
expr: CO2 = Biomass Loss × Carbon Fraction × 44/12

name: Methane GWP (100-yr)
expr: concept: methane has roughly 28–36 times the warming effect of CO2 over 100 years

name: Nitrous Oxide GWP (100-yr)
expr: concept: N2O has roughly 265–298 times the warming effect of CO2 over 100 years

name: Household Carbon Footprint
expr: CFhh = Energy Emissions + Transport Emissions + Food Emissions + Waste Emissions

name: Carbon Neutrality Point
expr: concept: the state where net anthropogenic CO2 emissions are balanced by removals

name: Embodied Carbon in Materials
expr: concept: total GHG emissions from producing and transporting a building material

name: Carbon Tax Liability
expr: Tax = Emissions (tCO2e) × Tax Rate per Tonne

name: Annual Emission Reduction Rate
expr: ERR = [(Base Year Emissions − Current Emissions)/Base Year Emissions] × 100

name: Air Quality Index (AQI)
expr: concept: a composite index summarizing ambient concentrations of key air pollutants

name: AQI Sub-Index Formula
expr: Ip = [(IHi − ILo)/(BPHi − BPLo)] × (Cp − BPLo) + ILo

name: PM2.5 Mass Concentration
expr: concept: mass of fine particulate matter (≤2.5 µm) per unit volume of air

name: PM10 Mass Concentration
expr: concept: mass of coarse particulate matter (≤10 µm) per unit volume of air

name: Air Pollution Index (API)
expr: concept: a normalized score comparing pollutant levels to health-based standards

name: Ozone 8-Hour Average
expr: concept: rolling 8-hour mean ground-level ozone concentration used for AQI reporting

name: NOx Emission Rate
expr: ENOx = Fuel Consumption × NOx Emission Factor

name: SO2 Emission from Combustion
expr: ESO2 = Fuel Mass × Sulfur Content × (64/32)

name: Carbon Monoxide Index
expr: concept: ambient CO concentration expressed relative to a health-based reference level

name: Total Suspended Particulates (TSP)
expr: concept: mass of all airborne particles, regardless of size, per unit air volume

name: Visibility Reduction (Koschmieder Equation)
expr: V = 3.912 / σext

name: Pollutant Standard Index (PSI)
expr: concept: a Singapore/Malaysia-style index combining several pollutants into one score

name: Air Dilution Ratio
expr: DR = Volume of Clean Air / Volume of Pollutant

name: Stack Emission Rate
expr: E = Concentration × Flue Gas Flow Rate

name: Ambient Standard Exceedance Ratio
expr: ESR = Measured Concentration / Regulatory Standard

name: Photochemical Smog Index
expr: concept: a rating of smog severity based on NOx, VOC and ozone interactions in sunlight

name: Acid Rain pH Threshold
expr: concept: precipitation with pH below about 5.6 is classified as acid rain

name: Sulfate Deposition Rate
expr: Fdep = Concentration × Deposition Velocity

name: NO2 Photolysis Rate
expr: concept: the rate at which sunlight breaks NO2 into NO and atomic oxygen, forming ozone

name: Indoor Air Ventilation Rate
expr: ACH = (Airflow Rate × 60) / Room Volume

name: Particulate Deposition Velocity
expr: concept: the effective settling speed of airborne particles onto a surface

name: Emission Concentration Correction to Reference O2
expr: Ccorr = Cmeasured × [(20.9 − O2ref)/(20.9 − O2measured)]

name: Air Quality Health Index (AQHI)
expr: concept: an index combining PM2.5, NO2 and O3 into a single health-risk number

name: Gaussian Plume Dispersion (concept)
expr: C(x,y,z) = [Q/(2πσyσzu)] × exp(−y²/2σy²) × [exp(−(z−H)²/2σz²) + exp(−(z+H)²/2σz²)]

name: Dissolved Oxygen Saturation
expr: concept: the percentage of oxygen dissolved in water relative to its maximum solubility

name: Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD)
expr: BOD = DOinitial − DOfinal (over 5-day incubation)

name: Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD)
expr: concept: the oxygen equivalent of organic matter oxidizable by a strong chemical oxidant

name: BOD/COD Ratio
expr: concept: a low ratio suggests non-biodegradable or toxic content in wastewater

name: Water Quality Index (WQI)
expr: WQI = Σ(Wi × Qi)

name: Total Dissolved Solids from Conductivity
expr: TDS ≈ EC (µS/cm) × 0.64

name: Turbidity
expr: concept: cloudiness of water caused by suspended particles, measured in NTU

name: pH Scale of Water
expr: concept: logarithmic scale of hydrogen ion activity; 7 is neutral, <7 acidic, >7 basic

name: Total Alkalinity
expr: concept: the water's capacity to neutralize acid, expressed as CaCO3 equivalent

name: Fecal Coliform Count
expr: concept: number of fecal coliform bacteria colonies per 100 mL of water sample

name: Dilution Factor for Effluent Discharge
expr: DF = (Stream Flow + Effluent Flow) / Effluent Flow

name: Nitrate Standard Comparison
expr: concept: nitrate-nitrogen concentration compared against the drinking water limit (10 mg/L NO3-N)

name: Phosphate Loading Rate
expr: PL = Concentration × Flow Rate

name: Salinity Estimate from TDS
expr: concept: salinity approximated from total dissolved solids using a conversion factor

name: Chlorine Demand
expr: CD = Chlorine Dosed − Residual Chlorine

name: Streeter-Phelps Oxygen Sag Model
expr: D = [kdL0/(ks − kd)](e^(−kdt) − e^(−kst)) + D0 e^(−kst)

name: Self-Purification Capacity of a River
expr: concept: a river's natural ability to assimilate and break down pollutant loads over distance

name: Heavy Metal Contamination Index (HMCI)
expr: concept: a weighted index combining measured heavy metal concentrations against standards

name: Water Pollution Load
expr: WPL = Concentration × Flow Rate

name: Langelier Saturation Index
expr: LSI = pH − pHs

name: Groundwater Contamination Index
expr: concept: an index reflecting the degree of aquifer contamination from multiple parameters

name: Nutrient Loading (N, P) into Water Body
expr: concept: total mass of nitrogen or phosphorus entering a water body per unit time

name: Bioconcentration Factor (BCF)
expr: BCF = Concentration in Organism / Concentration in Water

name: Coagulant Dose Requirement
expr: concept: optimum coagulant dose determined by jar testing for a given raw water turbidity

name: Hydraulic Detention Time
expr: t = Tank Volume / Flow Rate

name: Surface Overflow Rate
expr: SOR = Flow Rate / Surface Area

name: Filtration Rate
expr: FR = Flow Rate / Filter Area

name: Chlorine CT Value
expr: CT = Residual Chlorine Concentration × Contact Time

name: Sludge Volume Index (SVI)
expr: SVI = (Settled Sludge Volume × 1000) / MLSS

name: Mixed Liquor Suspended Solids (MLSS)
expr: concept: concentration of suspended solids in the aeration tank mixed liquor

name: Food-to-Microorganism (F/M) Ratio
expr: F/M = BOD Load / MLSS Mass

name: Hydraulic Retention Time (HRT)
expr: HRT = Reactor Volume / Flow Rate

name: Sludge Retention Time (SRT)
expr: SRT = Mass of Solids in System / Mass of Solids Wasted per Day

name: Organic Loading Rate
expr: OLR = BOD Load / Reactor Volume

name: Pollutant Removal Efficiency
expr: η = [(Influent − Effluent)/Influent] × 100

name: Aeration Tank Oxygen Requirement
expr: concept: theoretical oxygen needed for BOD removal and endogenous respiration

name: Reverse Osmosis Salt Rejection
expr: R = [1 − (Cpermeate/Cfeed)] × 100

name: Particle Settling Velocity (Stokes' Law)
expr: vs = [g(ρs − ρ)d²] / 18μ

name: Weir Loading Rate
expr: WLR = Flow Rate / Weir Length

name: Filter Backwash Rate
expr: concept: the upward flow rate applied to expand and clean filter media

name: Disinfection By-Product Formation
expr: concept: formation of compounds like trihalomethanes when chlorine reacts with organic matter

name: Sludge Production Rate
expr: concept: mass of biosolids generated per unit of BOD removed

name: Water Treatment Plant Design Capacity
expr: Q = Population Served × Per Capita Demand

name: Breakpoint Chlorination Curve
expr: concept: chlorine dose-residual relationship showing the point where free residual chlorine appears

name: Freundlich Adsorption Isotherm
expr: x/m = KfC^(1/n)

name: Membrane Flux Rate
expr: J = Permeate Volume / (Membrane Area × Time)

name: Total Suspended Solids Removal Efficiency
expr: η = [(TSSin − TSSout)/TSSin] × 100

name: Septic Tank Sizing
expr: V = Daily Wastewater Flow × Retention Time

name: Soil pH Scale
expr: concept: measure of hydrogen ion activity in soil solution indicating acidity or alkalinity

name: Soil Organic Matter (%)
expr: SOM% = (Loss on Ignition Weight / Dry Soil Weight) × 100

name: Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC)
expr: concept: total exchangeable cations a soil can hold, indicating fertility and buffering capacity

name: Soil Bulk Density
expr: ρb = Mass of Dry Soil / Total Soil Volume

name: Soil Porosity
expr: n = 1 − (Bulk Density / Particle Density)

name: Soil Moisture Content (%)
expr: MC% = [(Wet Weight − Dry Weight)/Dry Weight] × 100

name: Universal Soil Loss Equation (USLE)
expr: A = R × K × LS × C × P

name: Soil Contamination Index
expr: concept: an index comparing measured contaminant levels to background or guideline values

name: Heavy Metal Soil Pollution Index
expr: concept: weighted combination of soil heavy-metal concentrations relative to standards

name: Land Degradation Index
expr: concept: composite measure of soil, vegetation and productivity loss over time

name: Soil Nutrient Index (N-P-K)
expr: concept: rating of available nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium in soil

name: Leaching Index
expr: concept: estimate of how readily a solute moves downward through the soil profile

name: Infiltration Rate
expr: f = Volume Infiltrated / (Area × Time)

name: Soil Salinity (Electrical Conductivity)
expr: concept: soil salinity estimated from the electrical conductivity of a saturated paste extract

name: Sodium Adsorption Ratio (SAR)
expr: SAR = Na / √[(Ca + Mg)/2]

name: Soil Texture Classification
expr: concept: classification of soil by relative percentages of sand, silt and clay

name: Land Use Change Index
expr: concept: rate of change of a land cover category area over a given period

name: Desertification Vulnerability Index (ESAI-style)
expr: ESAI = (Sq × Cq × Mq)^(1/3)

name: Soil Carbon Sequestration Rate
expr: SCSR = Change in Soil Organic Carbon / Time

name: Pesticide Residue Concentration in Soil
expr: concept: mass of pesticide residue per unit mass of dry soil

name: Soil Nitrogen Mineralization Rate
expr: concept: rate at which organic nitrogen is converted to plant-available inorganic forms

name: Landfill Leachate Generation Rate (Water Balance Method)
expr: concept: leachate estimated from precipitation, runoff, evapotranspiration and storage change

name: Contaminant Retardation Factor
expr: R = 1 + (ρb × Kd)/θ

name: Soil Quality Index
expr: concept: an integrated score of physical, chemical and biological soil health indicators

name: Agricultural Land Productivity Index
expr: concept: crop yield per unit area normalized against a reference or potential yield

name: Population Density
expr: D = Number of Individuals / Area

name: Exponential Population Growth
expr: dN/dt = rN

name: Logistic Population Growth
expr: dN/dt = rN(1 − N/K)

name: Carrying Capacity (K)
expr: concept: the maximum population size an environment can sustainably support

name: Crude Birth Rate
expr: CBR = (Births / Population) × 1000

name: Crude Death Rate
expr: CDR = (Deaths / Population) × 1000

name: Net Reproductive Rate (R0)
expr: concept: average number of offspring produced by an individual over its lifetime

name: Population Doubling Time
expr: td = ln(2) / r

name: Age Structure Distribution
expr: concept: proportion of a population in pre-reproductive, reproductive and post-reproductive age classes

name: Survivorship Curve
expr: concept: a plot of the number of surviving individuals versus age, classified as Type I, II or III

name: Life Table Survival Rate
expr: lx = Number Surviving at Age x / Initial Cohort Size

name: Intrinsic Rate of Natural Increase
expr: r = b − d

name: Lotka-Volterra Predator-Prey Model
expr: concept: coupled equations describing oscillating predator and prey population dynamics

name: Competitive Exclusion Principle
expr: concept: two species competing for the same limiting resource cannot stably coexist

name: Niche Overlap Index
expr: concept: a measure of the degree two species share resource use along a niche axis

name: Jaccard Similarity Index
expr: J = c / (a + b − c)

name: Sorensen Similarity Index
expr: S = 2c / (a + b)

name: Species Dominance Index
expr: concept: proportion of total abundance contributed by the most common species

name: Ecological Succession Rate
expr: concept: rate at which a community's species composition changes following disturbance

name: Population Viability Analysis
expr: concept: modeling the probability a population persists over a given time given demographic factors

name: Metapopulation Dynamics
expr: concept: balance of local extinction and recolonization across habitat patches

name: Interspecific Competition Coefficient (α)
expr: concept: the per-capita effect of one species on the growth rate of another

name: Density-Dependent Growth Regulation
expr: concept: growth rate decreases as population density approaches carrying capacity

name: r- and K-Selection Strategies
expr: concept: r-selected species favor high reproduction, K-selected favor competitive efficiency

name: Community Species Richness
expr: S = Number of Distinct Species in a Defined Area

name: Gross Primary Productivity (GPP)
expr: concept: total rate of energy fixed by producers through photosynthesis

name: Ecosystem Net Primary Productivity
expr: NPP = GPP − Respiration (autotrophic)

name: Secondary Productivity
expr: concept: rate of biomass production by heterotrophs (consumers) in an ecosystem

name: Trophic Level Transfer Efficiency
expr: concept: roughly 10% of energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next

name: Ecological Efficiency
expr: EE = Production at Trophic Level n / Production at Trophic Level n−1

name: Assimilation Efficiency
expr: AE = Energy Assimilated / Energy Consumed

name: Production Efficiency
expr: PE = Production / Assimilation

name: Consumption Efficiency
expr: CE = Energy Consumed at Level n / Production at Level n−1

name: Biomass Pyramid
expr: concept: representation of total biomass at each trophic level, usually decreasing upward

name: Energy Pyramid
expr: concept: representation of energy flow through trophic levels, always decreasing upward

name: Standing Crop Biomass
expr: concept: total mass of living organisms present in an ecosystem at a given time

name: Litter Decomposition Rate
expr: concept: exponential decay model k = −ln(Xt/X0)/t for organic litter breakdown

name: Nutrient Cycling Rate
expr: concept: rate at which nutrients move between biotic and abiotic ecosystem compartments

name: Net Ecosystem Productivity (NEP)
expr: NEP = GPP − Total Ecosystem Respiration

name: Respiration-to-Photosynthesis Ratio (R/P)
expr: concept: an indicator of ecosystem metabolic balance; R/P > 1 indicates net heterotrophy

name: Food Chain Length
expr: concept: the number of trophic transfers between a basal resource and a top predator

name: Food Web Connectance
expr: C = L / S²

name: Detrital Energy Pathway
expr: concept: energy flow through decomposers processing dead organic matter

name: Grazing Efficiency
expr: concept: the fraction of net primary production consumed by herbivores

name: Turnover Rate of Biomass
expr: TR = Production / Standing Crop Biomass

name: Turnover Time
expr: Tt = Standing Crop Biomass / Production

name: Ecosystem Respiration Rate
expr: concept: total CO2 released by all organisms in an ecosystem per unit time

name: Photosynthetic Efficiency
expr: concept: fraction of incident solar energy converted into chemical energy by plants

name: Carbon-to-Energy Conversion in Biomass
expr: concept: approximate energy content of dry biomass, about 18–20 MJ/kg

name: Lindeman's Trophic Efficiency Rule
expr: concept: energy transfer efficiency between successive trophic levels averages about 10%

name: Species Richness Index
expr: S = Total Number of Species Observed

name: Shannon Diversity Index
expr: H' = −Σ(pi ln pi)

name: Simpson's Diversity Index
expr: D = 1 − Σ(pi²)

name: Simpson's Reciprocal Index
expr: 1/D = 1 / Σ(pi²)

name: Pielou's Species Evenness
expr: J' = H' / ln(S)

name: Margalef's Richness Index
expr: DMg = (S − 1) / ln(N)

name: Menhinick's Diversity Index
expr: DMn = S / √N

name: Berger-Parker Dominance Index
expr: d = Nmax / N

name: Gamma Diversity
expr: concept: total species diversity across a landscape combining alpha and beta diversity

name: Rarefaction Curve
expr: concept: expected species richness for a standardized sample size to allow fair comparison

name: Endemism Ratio
expr: concept: proportion of species found only within a defined geographic region

name: Habitat Fragmentation Index
expr: concept: a measure of how broken up a habitat has become relative to its original extent

name: Edge-to-Area Ratio
expr: EAR = Perimeter of Habitat Patch / Area of Habitat Patch

name: Species Area Relationship
expr: S = cAᶻ

name: Keystone Species Impact Index
expr: concept: disproportionate ecological effect of a species relative to its abundance

name: Functional Diversity Index
expr: concept: variety of ecological roles or traits represented among species in a community

name: Red List Index (Extinction Risk)
expr: concept: a composite trend of extinction risk across a set of species over time

name: Habitat Suitability Index
expr: concept: a score combining environmental variables to predict species presence likelihood

name: Biotic Index (Water Quality via Macroinvertebrates)
expr: concept: a score derived from pollution-tolerant vs pollution-sensitive aquatic species present

name: Corridor Connectivity Index
expr: concept: measure of how well habitat patches are linked by corridors for species movement

name: Genetic Diversity (Heterozygosity)
expr: H = Number of Heterozygous Individuals / Total Individuals

name: Community Evenness (Simpson's)
expr: E = D / Dmax

name: Invasive Species Impact Index
expr: concept: a composite score of an invasive species' spread rate and ecological damage

name: Conservation Priority Index
expr: concept: ranking of species or habitats for protection based on rarity and threat level

name: Radiative Forcing
expr: concept: the change in energy balance (W/m²) caused by a factor such as increased GHG concentration

name: Global Mean Surface Temperature Anomaly
expr: concept: deviation of average global temperature from a historical baseline period

name: Climate Sensitivity
expr: concept: the equilibrium temperature change resulting from a doubling of atmospheric CO2

name: Sea Level Rise Rate
expr: concept: rate of global mean sea level increase, driven by thermal expansion and ice melt

name: Thermal Expansion of Seawater
expr: ΔV = V0 × α × ΔT

name: Ice Sheet Mass Balance
expr: concept: net change in ice sheet mass from accumulation minus ablation and calving

name: Albedo Feedback Effect
expr: concept: reduced ice/snow cover lowers surface albedo, increasing absorbed solar radiation

name: Stefan-Boltzmann Radiative Balance
expr: E = σT⁴

name: Greenhouse Effect Energy Balance
expr: concept: incoming solar radiation balanced against outgoing longwave radiation trapped by GHGs

name: Keeling Curve CO2 Trend
expr: concept: long-term rising trend of atmospheric CO2 concentration with seasonal oscillation

name: Climate Feedback Loop (Positive/Negative)
expr: concept: a process that amplifies (positive) or dampens (negative) an initial climate change

name: Ocean Acidification (pH Change)
expr: concept: absorption of atmospheric CO2 lowers ocean pH through carbonic acid formation

name: Global Carbon Budget
expr: concept: remaining cumulative CO2 emissions allowed to stay within a given warming target

name: Cumulative Emissions-Temperature Relationship (TCRE)
expr: concept: near-linear relationship between cumulative CO2 emissions and global temperature rise

name: Climate Change Vulnerability Index
expr: concept: composite score of exposure, sensitivity and adaptive capacity to climate impacts

name: Degree Days (Heating/Cooling)
expr: HDD or CDD = Σ|Tbase − Tavg,daily|

name: Urban Heat Island Intensity
expr: ΔTuhi = Turban − Trural

name: Glacier Mass Balance
expr: concept: net gain or loss of glacier mass from accumulation and ablation over a year

name: Permafrost Thaw Depth
expr: concept: depth of seasonal thaw in permafrost, increasing with warming trends

name: Climate Model Emission Scenario (RCP/SSP)
expr: concept: representative pathways of future GHG concentrations used in climate projections

name: Ocean Heat Content
expr: concept: total thermal energy stored in the ocean, a key indicator of the planet's energy imbalance

name: Extreme Weather Event Frequency Trend
expr: concept: statistical trend in the frequency or intensity of extreme weather events over time

name: Global Warming Potential Time Horizon
expr: concept: GWP values depend on the chosen time horizon, commonly 20, 100, or 500 years

name: Anthropogenic Forcing vs Natural Forcing
expr: concept: comparison of human-driven versus natural (solar, volcanic) contributions to climate change

name: Paris Agreement Temperature Target Gap
expr: concept: gap between projected warming from current pledges and the 1.5°C/2°C target

name: Ideal Gas Law (Atmospheric Application)
expr: PV = nRT

name: Atmospheric Pressure with Altitude (Barometric Formula)
expr: P = P0 e^(−Mgh/RT)

name: Lapse Rate (Environmental)
expr: concept: rate of temperature decrease with increasing altitude in the troposphere, ~6.5°C/km

name: Dry Adiabatic Lapse Rate
expr: concept: rate of cooling of a rising unsaturated air parcel, about 9.8°C/km

name: Relative Humidity
expr: RH = (Actual Vapor Pressure / Saturation Vapor Pressure) × 100

name: Dew Point Temperature
expr: concept: temperature at which air becomes saturated and condensation begins

name: Wind Chill Index
expr: concept: apparent temperature felt on skin due to combined effect of wind and air temperature

name: Heat Index
expr: concept: apparent temperature combining air temperature and relative humidity

name: Coriolis Force Effect on Wind
expr: concept: deflects moving air due to Earth's rotation, right in N. hemisphere, left in S.

name: Geostrophic Wind Balance
expr: concept: wind resulting from balance between pressure gradient force and Coriolis force

name: Atmospheric Stability (Lapse Rate Comparison)
expr: concept: air is unstable when environmental lapse rate exceeds the adiabatic lapse rate

name: Evapotranspiration Rate (Penman Equation, concept)
expr: concept: estimates combined water loss from evaporation and plant transpiration

name: Precipitation Efficiency
expr: PE = Precipitation Reaching Surface / Total Moisture Available in Cloud

name: Cloud Condensation Nuclei Effect
expr: concept: aerosol particles that serve as sites for water vapor condensation into cloud droplets

name: Solar Constant
expr: concept: average solar radiation received per unit area at the top of Earth's atmosphere, ~1361 W/m²

name: Insolation at a Given Latitude
expr: concept: incoming solar radiation varies with latitude, season and time of day

name: Atmospheric Boundary Layer Height
expr: concept: the depth of the lowest atmospheric layer directly influenced by the Earth's surface

name: Air Mass Classification
expr: concept: classification of air masses by source region temperature and moisture characteristics

name: Beaufort Wind Scale
expr: concept: empirical scale relating observed wind effects to estimated wind speed

name: Ozone Layer Depletion (Ozone Column Thickness)
expr: concept: total atmospheric ozone measured in Dobson Units

name: Monsoon Onset Index
expr: concept: an indicator combining wind reversal and rainfall increase to define monsoon onset

name: Atmospheric CO2 Residence Time
expr: concept: estimated time an added CO2 molecule remains in the atmosphere before removal

name: Sea Breeze/Land Breeze Formation
expr: concept: local wind circulation driven by differential heating between land and sea surfaces

name: Temperature Inversion Layer
expr: concept: layer where temperature increases with height, trapping pollutants near the surface

name: Jet Stream Influence on Weather
expr: concept: high-altitude fast air currents that steer weather systems and storm tracks

name: Henry's Law (Gas Solubility)
expr: C = kH × P

name: Partition Coefficient (Octanol-Water, Kow)
expr: concept: ratio of a chemical's concentration in octanol vs water, indicating hydrophobicity

name: Bioaccumulation Factor (BAF)
expr: BAF = Concentration in Organism / Concentration in Environment

name: Biomagnification Factor
expr: concept: increase in contaminant concentration at each successive trophic level

name: First-Order Degradation Rate
expr: Ct = C0 e^(−kt)

name: Acid-Base Neutralization in Environmental Systems
expr: concept: reaction of acidic pollutants with basic buffering agents such as carbonates

name: Redox Potential (Eh) in Natural Waters
expr: concept: a measure of the oxidizing or reducing conditions in soil or water

name: Chelation of Heavy Metals
expr: concept: binding of metal ions by organic ligands, affecting their mobility and toxicity

name: Photolysis Rate Constant
expr: concept: rate at which a pollutant breaks down under sunlight exposure

name: Hydrolysis Rate of Pesticides
expr: concept: rate at which a pesticide degrades via reaction with water

name: Solubility Product (Ksp) for Mineral Precipitation
expr: Ksp = [A⁺][B⁻]

name: Ozone Formation Reaction (Photochemistry)
expr: concept: NOx and VOCs react in sunlight to form ground-level ozone

name: Acid Rain Formation (SO2/NOx Reactions)
expr: concept: SO2 and NOx react with atmospheric water to form sulfuric and nitric acid

name: Persistent Organic Pollutant (POP) Stability
expr: concept: resistance of certain organic compounds to environmental degradation

name: Volatilization Rate of a Chemical
expr: concept: rate at which a dissolved chemical transfers from water to the atmosphere

name: Adsorption Coefficient (Koc)
expr: concept: measure of a chemical's tendency to bind to organic carbon in soil or sediment

name: Nitrogen Cycle Transformation Rates
expr: concept: rates of nitrification, denitrification, and nitrogen fixation in an ecosystem

name: Phosphorus Cycle Sediment Release Rate
expr: concept: rate of phosphorus release from sediments back into the overlying water column

name: Ozone Depletion Reaction (Chlorine Catalytic Cycle)
expr: concept: chlorine radicals catalytically destroy stratospheric ozone molecules

name: Environmental Persistence (DT50)
expr: concept: time required for 50% of a chemical to degrade under field conditions

name: Electrochemical Corrosion Rate in Pollution Context
expr: concept: rate of metal degradation accelerated by acidic or polluted environments

name: Buffer Capacity of Natural Water
expr: concept: a water body's ability to resist pH change upon addition of acid or base

name: Speciation of Heavy Metals in Water
expr: concept: distribution of a metal among its free ion, complexed, and particulate forms

name: Greenhouse Gas Mixing Ratio
expr: concept: concentration of a gas expressed as parts per million or billion by volume

name: Solar Panel Efficiency
expr: η = (Electrical Power Output / Solar Power Input) × 100

name: Solar Energy Received on a Surface
expr: E = Solar Irradiance × Area × Time

name: Wind Turbine Power Output
expr: P = ½ρAv³Cp

name: Wind Turbine Capacity Factor
expr: CF = Actual Energy Output / (Rated Power × Time)

name: Hydropower Output
expr: P = ρgQH

name: Biomass Energy Content
expr: E = Mass of Biomass × Calorific Value

name: Biogas Yield from Organic Waste
expr: concept: volume of methane-rich gas produced per unit mass of digested organic matter

name: Geothermal Energy Potential
expr: concept: usable heat energy extracted from subsurface thermal gradients

name: Energy Payback Time
expr: EPBT = Embodied Energy of System / Annual Energy Output

name: Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE)
expr: LCOE = Total Lifetime Cost / Total Lifetime Energy Output

name: Renewable Energy Penetration Rate
expr: REP = Renewable Energy Generated / Total Energy Generated × 100

name: Energy Return on Investment (EROI)
expr: EROI = Energy Delivered by a Source / Energy Used to Obtain It

name: Solar Photovoltaic Degradation Rate
expr: concept: annual percentage decline in a solar panel's power output over its lifetime

name: Battery Storage Efficiency (Round-Trip)
expr: η = Energy Discharged / Energy Charged × 100

name: Sustainable Yield of a Resource
expr: concept: the maximum harvest rate that keeps a renewable resource stock stable over time

name: Ecological Footprint
